verdict.rationale: Filee is an offline desktop file converter with no AI or agent component. Acting as an MCP client that calls other servers' tools is an agent capability, so this is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows MCP or any LLM tool-use; the CLI and JSON output are not MCP-client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
